feature_title: Alert Creation Redirect Preserves Org Identifier

rationale.edition: The only changed file is web/src/components/alerts/AddAlert.vue, a Vue component under the open-source web/src tree. No enterprise-owned paths (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/) and no enterprise keywords (cipher/SAML/RBAC/SDR/logo-management) are present, so this is an open-source change.
rationale.skip: No skip markers apply: the trigger comment and feature hint are empty and no tests-added label was passed. The change is in a user-facing Vue component (web/src/**), not docs/CI/test-data only, so the no-user-facing-change skip does not trigger.
rationale.e2e: The change alters a user-facing UI flow: after saving an alert, AddAlert.vue now appends org_identifier to the redirect query string when navigating to /alerts. This navigation/state change is user-exercisable and worth an E2E check.
rationale.area: The changed file lives in web/src/components/alerts/ and sibling Playwright specs live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Alerts/, so Alerts is the correct product area.
rationale.group: The Alerts shard (testfolder 'Alerts', actual_folder 'Alerts') already exists in the ci-matrix and runs alert specs such as alerts-e2e-flow.spec.js, so the new spec should join that group.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E Playwright specs under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ are changed in the diff; the only changed file is web/src/components/alerts/AddAlert.vue. There are no existing E2E specs in the diff.
